headline: Every measured metric changed by less than its sampling noise. The data does not distinguish this change from no change.

comparisons.label: Control delay
comparisons.explanation: The difference of -0.20 has a 95% confidence interval of [-1.71, +1.31], which contains zero. The measurement does not distinguish this change from no change at all.

comparisons.label: Control delay
comparisons.explanation: 3 sample(s) before and 3 after; 8 are required on each side. A test on fewer would lack the power to detect a real change, so 'no measurable change' would be meaningless.

method: Welch's unequal-variance t-test with a 95% confidence interval on the difference of means.
method_caveats: Demand is not controlled for: traffic may have changed independently of the signal change.
This is an observational before/after comparison, not a randomised trial.
Metrics are compared independently; no correction is applied for multiple comparisons.
